# 故障治理

> **版本**：v1.0
> **最后更新**：2026-04-24

## 📚 概念介绍

故障治理是保障系统稳定运行的关键能力。本节将深入讲解故障检测与自愈、优雅降级策略、混沌工程和故障演练。

## 🎯 故障检测与自愈

### 健康检查机制

```js
// 健康检查系统
class HealthCheckSystem {
  constructor(config) {
    this.checks = new Map()
    this.interval = config.interval || 10000
    this.threshold = config.threshold || 3  // 连续失败次数阈值
    this.running = false
  }

  // 注册健康检查
  register(name, checkFn) {
    this.checks.set(name, {
      fn: checkFn,
      failures: 0,
      lastCheck: null,
      status: 'unknown'
    })
  }

  // 执行健康检查
  async check(name) {
    const check = this.checks.get(name)
    if (!check) {
      throw new Error(`Health check ${name} not found`)
    }

    try {
      const result = await check.fn()
      check.failures = 0
      check.status = 'healthy'
      check.lastCheck = Date.now()
      return { name, status: 'healthy', result }
    } catch (error) {
      check.failures++
      check.status = check.failures >= this.threshold ? 'unhealthy' : 'degraded'
      check.lastCheck = Date.now()
      
      if (check.status === 'unhealthy') {
        this.triggerAutoHealing(name, error)
      }
      
      return { name, status: check.status, error: error.message }
    }
  }

  // 执行所有健康检查
  async checkAll() {
    const results = []
    for (const name of this.checks.keys()) {
      const result = await this.check(name)
      results.push(result)
    }
    return results
  }

  // 启动定期检查
  start() {
    if (this.running) return
    
    this.running = true
    this.timer = setInterval(async () => {
      await this.checkAll()
    }, this.interval)
    
    console.log('[HealthCheck] Started')
  }

  // 停止定期检查
  stop() {
    if (!this.running) return
    
    this.running = false
    clearInterval(this.timer)
    console.log('[HealthCheck] Stopped')
  }

  // 触发自愈
  async triggerAutoHealing(name, error) {
    console.log(`[AutoHealing] Triggered for ${name}:`, error.message)
    
    // 实际项目中这里会执行自愈操作
    // 例如：重启服务、切换流量、清理资源等
  }
}

// 使用示例
const healthSystem = new HealthCheckSystem({
  interval: 5000,
  threshold: 3
})

// 注册健康检查
healthSystem.register('database', async () => {
  // 模拟数据库健康检查
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
  if (Math.random() > 0.8) {
    throw new Error('Database connection failed')
  }
  return { connected: true, latency: 10 }
})

healthSystem.register('cache', async () => {
  // 模拟缓存健康检查
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50))
  return { connected: true, memory: '45%' }
})

healthSystem.register('api', async () => {
  // 模拟 API 健康检查
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 20))
  return { status: 'ok', uptime: 3600 }
})

// 启动健康检查
healthSystem.start()

// 手动执行检查
async function testHealthCheck() {
  const results = await healthSystem.checkAll()
  console.log('Health check results:', results)
}

testHealthCheck()
```

### 自愈机制

```js
// 自愈系统
class SelfHealingSystem {
  constructor(config) {
    this.strategies = new Map()
    this.history = []
  }

  // 注册自愈策略
  register(name, strategy) {
    this.strategies.set(name, strategy)
  }

  // 执行自愈
  async heal(fault) {
    console.log(`[SelfHealing] Attempting to heal: ${fault.type}`)
    
    const strategy = this.strategies.get(fault.type)
    if (!strategy) {
      console.log(`[SelfHealing] No strategy found for ${fault.type}`)
      return { success: false, reason: 'No strategy' }
    }

    try {
      const result = await strategy.execute(fault)
      this.recordHistory(fault, result)
      return { success: true, result }
    } catch (error) {
      this.recordHistory(fault, { success: false, error: error.message })
      return { success: false, error: error.message }
    }
  }

  // 记录历史
  recordHistory(fault, result) {
    this.history.push({
      fault,
      result,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    })
    
    // 只保留最近 100 条记录
    if (this.history.length > 100) {
      this.history.shift()
    }
  }

  // 获取历史记录
  getHistory() {
    return this.history
  }
}

// 自愈策略
class RestartStrategy {
  async execute(fault) {
    console.log(`[RestartStrategy] Restarting service: ${fault.service}`)
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000))
    return { action: 'restarted', service: fault.service }
  }
}

class ScaleUpStrategy {
  async execute(fault) {
    console.log(`[ScaleUpStrategy] Scaling up: ${fault.service}`)
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))
    return { action: 'scaled', service: fault.service, instances: fault.instances + 1 }
  }
}

class ClearCacheStrategy {
  async execute(fault) {
    console.log(`[ClearCacheStrategy] Clearing cache: ${fault.cache}`)
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
    return { action: 'cleared', cache: fault.cache }
  }
}

// 使用示例
const healingSystem = new SelfHealingSystem()

// 注册自愈策略
healingSystem.register('service_crash', new RestartStrategy())
healingSystem.register('high_load', new ScaleUpStrategy())
healingSystem.register('cache_full', new ClearCacheStrategy())

// 模拟故障
async function testSelfHealing() {
  const faults = [
    { type: 'service_crash', service: 'api-server' },
    { type: 'high_load', service: 'worker', instances: 3 },
    { type: 'cache_full', cache: 'redis' }
  ]

  for (const fault of faults) {
    const result = await healingSystem.heal(fault)
    console.log('Healing result:', result)
  }

  console.log('\nHealing history:')
  console.log(healingSystem.getHistory())
}

testSelfHealing()
```

## 🎯 优雅降级策略

### 降级策略实现

```js
// 降级系统
class DegradationSystem {
  constructor(config) {
    this.strategies = new Map()
    this.currentLevel = 'normal'  // normal | degraded | minimal
    this.metrics = {
      errors: 0,
      requests: 0,
      lastReset: Date.now()
    }
  }

  // 注册降级策略
  register(feature, strategy) {
    this.strategies.set(feature, strategy)
  }

  // 执行功能（自动降级）
  async execute(feature, fn) {
    this.metrics.requests++
    
    try {
      const result = await fn()
      return { success: true, data: result }
    } catch (error) {
      this.metrics.errors++
      console.log(`[Degradation] Error in ${feature}:`, error.message)
      
      // 检查是否需要降级
      this.checkDegradationLevel()
      
      // 执行降级策略
      const strategy = this.strategies.get(feature)
      if (strategy) {
        const fallback = strategy.getFallback(this.currentLevel)
        if (fallback) {
          console.log(`[Degradation] Using fallback for ${feature}`)
          return { success: true, data: fallback(), degraded: true }
        }
      }
      
      throw error
    }
  }

  // 检查降级级别
  checkDegradationLevel() {
    const errorRate = this.metrics.errors / this.metrics.requests
    const timeSinceReset = Date.now() - this.metrics.lastReset
    
    // 每分钟重置一次
    if (timeSinceReset > 60000) {
      this.metrics.errors = 0
      this.metrics.requests = 0
      this.metrics.lastReset = Date.now()
    }
    
    // 根据错误率调整降级级别
    if (errorRate > 0.5) {
      this.currentLevel = 'minimal'
    } else if (errorRate > 0.2) {
      this.currentLevel = 'degraded'
    } else {
      this.currentLevel = 'normal'
    }
    
    console.log(`[Degradation] Current level: ${this.currentLevel}, error rate: ${errorRate.toFixed(2)}`)
  }

  // 手动设置降级级别
  setLevel(level) {
    this.currentLevel = level
    console.log(`[Degradation] Level set to: ${level}`)
  }

  // 获取当前状态
  getStatus() {
    return {
      level: this.currentLevel,
      metrics: this.metrics,
      errorRate: this.metrics.requests > 0 ? this.metrics.errors / this.metrics.requests : 0
    }
  }
}

// 降级策略
class FeatureStrategy {
  constructor(fallbacks) {
    this.fallbacks = fallbacks
  }

  getFallback(level) {
    return this.fallbacks[level]
  }
}

// 使用示例
const degradationSystem = new DegradationSystem()

// 注册降级策略
degradationSystem.register('recommendation', new FeatureStrategy({
  normal: null,
  degraded: () => ({ items: [], message: 'Recommendations temporarily unavailable' }),
  minimal: () => ({ items: [], message: 'Service maintenance' })
}))

degradationSystem.register('comments', new FeatureStrategy({
  normal: null,
  degraded: () => ({ comments: [], message: 'Comments loading slowly' }),
  minimal: () => ({ comments: [], message: 'Comments disabled' })
}))

// 模拟功能执行
async function testDegradation() {
  // 正常执行
  const result1 = await degradationSystem.execute('recommendation', async () => {
    return { items: ['item1', 'item2', 'item3'] }
  })
  console.log('Result 1:', result1)

  // 模拟错误
  const result2 = await degradationSystem.execute('recommendation', async () => {
    throw new Error('Service unavailable')
  })
  console.log('Result 2:', result2)

  // 查看状态
  console.log('\nStatus:', degradationSystem.getStatus())

  // 手动降级
  degradationSystem.setLevel('minimal')

  // 再次执行
  const result3 = await degradationSystem.execute('comments', async () => {
    throw new Error('Service unavailable')
  })
  console.log('Result 3:', result3)
}

testDegradation()
```

## 🎯 混沌工程

### 混沌实验

```js
// 混沌工程系统
class ChaosEngineering {
  constructor(config) {
    this.experiments = new Map()
    this.running = false
    this.metrics = {
      total: 0,
      passed: 0,
      failed: 0
    }
  }

  // 注册混沌实验
  register(name, experiment) {
    this.experiments.set(name, experiment)
  }

  // 执行混沌实验
  async run(name) {
    const experiment = this.experiments.get(name)
    if (!experiment) {
      throw new Error(`Experiment ${name} not found`)
    }

    console.log(`[Chaos] Starting experiment: ${name}`)
    this.metrics.total++

    try {
      // 1. 建立稳态
      const baseline = await experiment.establishBaseline()
      console.log(`[Chaos] Baseline established:`, baseline)

      // 2. 引入故障
      console.log(`[Chaos] Injecting fault...`)
      await experiment.injectFault()

      // 3. 观察系统行为
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, experiment.duration))

      // 4. 验证稳态
      const afterFault = await experiment.measureState()
      const passed = experiment.validateSteadyState(baseline, afterFault)

      if (passed) {
        this.metrics.passed++
        console.log(`[Chaos] Experiment passed: ${name}`)
      } else {
        this.metrics.failed++
        console.log(`[Chaos] Experiment failed: ${name}`)
        console.log(`[Chaos] Baseline:`, baseline)
        console.log(`[Chaos] After fault:`, afterFault)
      }

      return { name, passed, baseline, afterFault }
    } catch (error) {
      this.metrics.failed++
      console.error(`[Chaos] Experiment error: ${name}`, error)
      return { name, passed: false, error: error.message }
    } finally {
      // 5. 恢复系统
      await experiment.recover()
      console.log(`[Chaos] System recovered`)
    }
  }

  // 获取指标
  getMetrics() {
    return this.metrics
  }
}

// 混沌实验
class NetworkLatencyExperiment {
  constructor(config) {
    this.service = config.service
    this.latency = config.latency || 5000
    this.duration = config.duration || 10000
    this.originalLatency = 0
  }

  async establishBaseline() {
    // 测量正常延迟
    const start = Date.now()
    await this.service.ping()
    this.originalLatency = Date.now() - start
    return { latency: this.originalLatency }
  }

  async injectFault() {
    // 注入网络延迟
    this.service.setLatency(this.latency)
    console.log(`[Chaos] Injected ${this.latency}ms latency`)
  }

  async measureState() {
    // 测量故障后状态
    const start = Date.now()
    await this.service.ping()
    const currentLatency = Date.now() - start
    return { latency: currentLatency }
  }

  validateSteadyState(baseline, afterFault) {
    // 验证系统是否仍能正常工作
    // 即使延迟增加，系统仍应能响应
    return afterFault.latency < this.latency * 2
  }

  async recover() {
    // 恢复正常延迟
    this.service.setLatency(this.originalLatency)
  }
}

// 模拟服务
class MockService {
  constructor() {
    this.latency = 0
  }

  async ping() {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, this.latency))
    return { status: 'ok' }
  }

  setLatency(ms) {
    this.latency = ms
  }
}

// 使用示例
const chaos = new ChaosEngineering()

const service = new MockService()

// 注册混沌实验
chaos.register('network_latency', new NetworkLatencyExperiment({
  service: service,
  latency: 5000,
  duration: 5000
}))

// 执行实验
async function testChaosEngineering() {
  const result = await chaos.run('network_latency')
  console.log('Experiment result:', result)

  console.log('\nChaos metrics:', chaos.getMetrics())
}

testChaosEngineering()
```

### 故障演练

```js
// 故障演练系统
class GameDay {
  constructor(config) {
    this.scenarios = new Map()
    this.participants = []
    this.timeline = []
  }

  // 注册演练场景
  register(name, scenario) {
    this.scenarios.set(name, scenario)
  }

  // 添加参与者
  addParticipant(participant) {
    this.participants.push(participant)
  }

  // 执行演练
  async run(name) {
    const scenario = this.scenarios.get(name)
    if (!scenario) {
      throw new Error(`Scenario ${name} not found`)
    }

    console.log(`[GameDay] Starting scenario: ${name}`)
    console.log(`[GameDay] Participants:`, this.participants.map(p => p.name))

    const startTime = Date.now()
    let completed = false
    let recoveryTime = null

    try {
      // 1. 通知参与者
      this.notifyParticipants(`GameDay ${name} starting`)

      // 2. 执行故障注入
      this.recordEvent('fault_injected', { scenario: name })
      await scenario.injectFault()

      // 3. 等待参与者响应
      await this.waitForResponse(scenario.timeout)

      // 4. 验证恢复
      const recovered = await scenario.verifyRecovery()
      if (recovered) {
        completed = true
        recoveryTime = Date.now() - startTime
        this.recordEvent('recovery_verified', { time: recoveryTime })
      }

    } catch (error) {
      this.recordEvent('error', { message: error.message })
    } finally {
      // 5. 清理
      await scenario.cleanup()
      this.notifyParticipants(`GameDay ${name} completed`)
    }

    return {
      scenario: name,
      completed,
      recoveryTime,
      timeline: this.timeline
    }
  }

  notifyParticipants(message) {
    console.log(`[GameDay] Notifying participants: ${message}`)
    this.participants.forEach(p => p.notify(message))
  }

  async waitForResponse(timeout) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, timeout))
  }

  recordEvent(type, data) {
    this.timeline.push({
      type,
      data,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    })
  }

  getTimeline() {
    return this.timeline
  }
}

// 演练场景
class DatabaseFailureScenario {
  constructor(config) {
    this.database = config.database
    this.timeout = config.timeout || 30000
  }

  async injectFault() {
    console.log('[GameDay] Injecting database failure...')
    this.database.fail()
  }

  async verifyRecovery() {
    console.log('[GameDay] Verifying database recovery...')
    const recovered = await this.database.isHealthy()
    return recovered
  }

  async cleanup() {
    console.log('[GameDay] Cleaning up...')
    this.database.recover()
  }
}

// 模拟参与者
class Participant {
  constructor(name) {
    this.name = name
  }

  notify(message) {
    console.log(`[Participant ${this.name}] Received: ${message}`)
  }
}

// 模拟数据库
class MockDatabase {
  constructor() {
    this.failed = false
  }

  fail() {
    this.failed = true
  }

  recover() {
    this.failed = false
  }

  async isHealthy() {
    return !this.failed
  }
}

// 使用示例
const gameDay = new GameDay()

const database = new MockDatabase()

// 注册演练场景
gameDay.register('database_failure', new DatabaseFailureScenario({
  database: database,
  timeout: 20000
}))

// 添加参与者
gameDay.addParticipant(new Participant('ops-team'))
gameDay.addParticipant(new Participant('dev-team'))

// 执行演练
async function testGameDay() {
  const result = await gameDay.run('database_failure')
  console.log('GameDay result:', result)

  console.log('\nTimeline:')
  gameDay.getTimeline().forEach(event => {
    console.log(`- ${event.type}:`, event.data)
  })
}

testGameDay()
```

## 📝 实际应用示例

### 综合故障治理系统

```js
// 综合故障治理系统
class ComprehensiveFaultManagement {
  constructor(config) {
    this.healthCheck = new HealthCheckSystem(config.healthCheck)
    this.selfHealing = new SelfHealingSystem()
    this.degradation = new DegradationSystem(config.degradation)
    this.chaos = new ChaosEngineering()
  }

  // 初始化
  async initialize() {
    // 注册健康检查
    this.healthCheck.register('service', async () => {
      return { status: 'ok' }
    })

    // 注册自愈策略
    this.selfHealing.register('restart', new RestartStrategy())

    // 注册降级策略
    this.degradation.register('feature', new FeatureStrategy({
      normal: null,
      degraded: () => ({ message: 'Degraded mode' }),
      minimal: () => ({ message: 'Minimal mode' })
    }))

    // 启动健康检查
    this.healthCheck.start()
  }

  // 处理故障
  async handleFault(fault) {
    console.log(`[FaultManagement] Handling fault: ${fault.type}`)

    // 1. 执行自愈
    const healResult = await this.selfHealing.heal(fault)
    
    if (healResult.success) {
      return { status: 'healed', result: healResult.result }
    }

    // 2. 执行降级
    if (fault.feature) {
      const degradeResult = await this.degradation.execute(
        fault.feature,
        async () => { throw new Error(fault.error) }
      )
      
      if (degradeResult.success) {
        return { status: 'degraded', data: degradeResult.data }
      }
    }

    // 3. 无法恢复
    return { status: 'failed', error: fault.error }
  }

  // 获取系统状态
  getStatus() {
    return {
      health: 'running',
      degradation: this.degradation.getStatus(),
      healing: this.selfHealing.getHistory()
    }
  }

  // 执行混沌实验
  async runExperiment(name) {
    return await this.chaos.run(name)
  }
}

// 使用示例
async function testComprehensiveFaultManagement() {
  const system = new ComprehensiveFaultManagement({
    healthCheck: { interval: 10000 },
    degradation: {}
  })

  await system.initialize()

  console.log('--- 处理故障 ---')
  const fault1 = {
    type: 'restart',
    service: 'api-server'
  }
  const result1 = await system.handleFault(fault1)
  console.log('Fault 1 result:', result1)

  console.log('\n--- 处理需要降级的故障 ---')
  const fault2 = {
    type: 'feature_error',
    feature: 'recommendation',
    error: 'Service unavailable'
  }
  const result2 = await system.handleFault(fault2)
  console.log('Fault 2 result:', result2)

  console.log('\n--- 系统状态 ---')
  console.log('System status:', system.getStatus())
}

testComprehensiveFaultManagement()
```

## 🔗 相关概念

- **健康检查**：定期检查系统组件状态
- **自愈机制**：自动检测并修复故障
- **优雅降级**：在故障时提供降级服务
- **混沌工程**：主动注入故障验证系统韧性
- **故障演练**：模拟真实故障场景进行演练
- **熔断器**：防止级联故障的保护机制
- **限流**：保护系统免受过载影响
- **监控告警**：及时发现和响应故障
